description: This file defines a Fragment class for an Android application that manages immersive mode toggling, system UI visibility, and logs UI changes. It handles user interactions via menu items and monitors system UI changes to update the UI dynamically.

classes.name: BasicImmersiveModeFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that provides immersive mode toggling functionality and system UI visibility handling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment and sets the option to handle menu actions.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Sets up a listener to monitor system UI visibility changes and logs the current height.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, specifically toggling immersive mode.

methods.name: toggleHideyBar
methods.description: Detects current immersive mode state and toggles UI visibility flags to enter or exit immersive mode, with logging.
